 Order
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking permission of the Court to withdraw the petition, with liberty to file an appeal.
The memo is placed on record.
In view of the memo, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty as prayed for.

The Registry is directed to return the documents produced by the petitioner along with this petition,
if an application is moved to that effect, before the Registry.
